name: patch
description: Saves the decisions you make in Claude Code to your Patch project, so you never have to reconstruct the why later.

patch_token.title: Patch access token
patch_token.description: A personal access token (starts with patch_pat_). Create one in Patch: sidebar > Access tokens (app.getpatchapp.com/access-tokens).

project_id.title: Patch project id
project_id.description: The project new decisions go to. Ask Claude to run list_projects from the Patch MCP server if you don't know it.

auto_capture.title: Save decisions when a session ends
auto_capture.description: When on, Patch reads each finished session and saves the 0 to 3 real decisions in it.

min_user_turns.title: Shortest session to read
min_user_turns.description: Sessions with fewer of your messages than this are skipped.

api_base_url.title: Patch API base URL
api_base_url.description: Leave as is unless you run your own Patch backend.
